_comment: Carvera aluminium inventory: aluminium-relevant subset of Essential Milling Bit Set - Standard (26 pcs), not a claim that six cutting bits ship with the machine. Read 2026-11-09: https://global.makera.com/products/carvera-tool-kits confirms a free starter toolkit but does not itemise bits; https://core-electronics.com.au/guides/cnc-milling/getting-started-with-the-makera-carvera-setup-and-first-cut/ lists mixed-material starter tools and a test rod in slot 6. Use the itemised 26-pc set instead: https://core-electronics.com.au/makera-common-milling-bits-26-pcs.html . All shanks 3.175 mm; no optional collet. Geometry and Aluminum presets read directly from Makera Fusion libraries (per-tool URLs), facts transcribed, no vendor files redistributed. Aluminum is a generic preset, not specifically 6082. Ball ends omitted: no resources/camlib adapter type. Corn/wood bits omitted. M5 has a 4 mm cutting head on a 3.175 mm shank. Inventory exceeds six pockets; load per setup. All source read dates 2026-11-09.

machines._comment: Read 2026-11-09 https://www.makera.com/products/carvera : travel 360x240x140 mm, spindle 200 W / 15000 rpm, custom integrated 1/8 inch collet (optional 1/4 inch, 6/4/3 mm), tool library size 6, maximum travel speed 6000 mm/min. Default 3.175 mm collet fitted. Placeholder vise: rectangular jaws, thickness conservatively equal to height; not validated workholding.

_policy: step2cam judgement: end-mill stepover 0.4D (Makera does not enable a stepover); stickout=Fusion assemblyGaugeLength, treated as tool projection, holder_length=10 mm and holder_diameter=8 mm are conservative collar/collet envelopes, not measured assemblies. Coolant off follows disabled presets; use external air assist for chip evacuation (machine air capability is separate; schema has no air tool coolant). Thread presets have contradictory flood/disabled expression: use off, not flood on this machine. Thread radial_passes=2, spring_passes=1 are step2cam judgement; published LCF is used as axial tooth envelope, not a measured single tooth. Global allowances/clearances/tolerances and rapid=5000 remain step2cam judgement (below sourced 6000 mm/min travel speed). End-mill RPM/feed round Fusion conversion noise to nearest integer.
